marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 20 knots this morning then
diminishing to light Sunday morning. Wind increasing to south 20 Sunday
afternoon. Snow changing to scattered flurries overnight and ending
Sunday morning. Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>
